brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration
Create ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1792x1024 or 1536x864, at least 1000 pixels wide. A striking handmade ink and brush sports illustration, emphatically illustrated, not photographic.
Style reference viewed in this conversation: B-culver-black-lime-v3.png. Match its near-black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B brush streaks, warm ivory heavy Japanese typography, rough expressive ink crosshatching, small amount of orange basketball color, and restrained number of elements. Do not carry over any Culver text, date, score, player or shooting pose.
Editorial content is ONLY the supplied fixed article dated 2026-10-25: an analysis comparing pregame season-average EFF and scheduled matchups, focusing on Okayama versus Tokushima. Results and participation were unconfirmed in that article. No final score, no winner, no game highlights claim.

Real subjects, exactly TWO players, using the official profile photographs already viewed in this conversation for facial likeness only:
1. Reynaldo Garcia / レイナルド・ガルシア (official Tryhoop Okayama portrait, https://tryhoop.com/files/user/raynaldo_garcia_hp_main.png): muscular dark-skinned man, very short close-cropped black hair and precise hairline, especially distinctive LONG thick full black beard tapering down the chest, connected moustache, strong broad nose, serious deep-set dark eyes, rounded strong brow, tattooed upper arms. This is the man with the long beard in the reference, not the man from the style sample.
2. Rapolas Ivanauskas / ラポラス・アイヴァナーカス (official Tokushima portrait, https://gambarous.jp/files/user/25-rapo.jpg): much taller lean broad-shouldered fair-skinned man, straight brown hair with textured fringe forward across forehead, long angular face, blue eyes, prominent straight nose, thin brown moustache and otherwise largely clean shaven, no full beard.
Transform both into hand-drawn ink illustrations. Do not paste, trace as photographic cutouts, or reproduce official photographs.
Scene: expressive one-on-one basketball play concept, NOT a reconstruction of a documented moment. On the right 55% of the composition show Garcia in the nearer foreground leaning diagonally into a driving step, controlling an orange basketball low at his side with a natural five-finger hand. Ivanauskas is a step farther back to the right, taller and in a low athletic defensive stance, looking toward Garcia, one arm naturally extended sideways and the other bent. Clear separate torsos, arms, hands and readable faces in three-quarter views; no merging, no extra limbs, no distorted fingers. Players from heads to around knees, lower legs may be intentionally outside frame; no chopped head, face, hand, or basketball. Stylized blank basketball uniforms with no lettering, no numbers, no badges, no branding: Garcia dark jersey with ivory piping, Ivanauskas ivory jersey with subtle dark trim. No team or league logos, no sponsor logos, no additional persons, no photo realism.
Composition: strong typographic block on the left 45%, face and figure action on right. Energetic lime diagonal brushwork connects the whole scene. Keep text off faces and hands. At least 4% safe margins for all text, both heads and visible hands. Clear hierarchy, no busy scoreboard or tables.
Render ONLY these exact Japanese text lines, impeccably spelled, sharp and readable:
Small top left: 「バスケまとめ」
Small date below: 「2026.10.25」
Main headline, very large on two lines: 「岡山 vs 徳島」
「上位対決を比較」
Supporting compact lime label above the main headline: 「今季平均EFF」
A clear smaller editorial qualifier below the headline: 「試合前比較｜結果未確認」
Bottom footer, clearly readable ivory on dark: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Next to it or below: 「成績をもとにしたイメージ」
No quotation brackets in rendered text. Do not render player names, statistics, scores, extra slogans or any other text. The words 上位対決 are explicitly framed as 今季平均EFF and 試合前比較, never a confirmed on-court meeting. The artwork is conceptual and the footer must be visible. Produce one polished thumbnail only.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit the FIRST image, the generated basketball thumbnail. Images 2 and 3 are OFFICIAL FACE REFERENCES ONLY: Reynaldo Garcia (long black beard) and Rapolas Ivanauskas (brown fringe and a narrow light moustache).
Make ONE targeted finishing correction to composition and anatomy while preserving the typography, text, palette, brushwork, illustrated style, the two real players, and their relative poses:
- Shrink and reposition the entire two-player-and-ball illustration enough that the ENTIRE orange basketball is inside the frame, with at least 45 pixels of dark-background clearance beneath it. Keep all of Garcia's ball-control fingertips inside and clearly visible. The basketball must not touch the bottom edge.
- Keep the entirety of Ivanauskas's hair inside with at least 40 pixels above. Give his rightmost visible hand and elbow breathing room on the right. Lower legs may be cropped deliberately, but never heads, hands or ball. Do not extend or crop the canvas; preserve landscape approx 16:9.
- Correct all visible hands to natural basketball anatomy, exactly five digits per hand (one thumb plus four fingers), no duplicated or fused fingers. Garcia's controlling hand rests naturally on the upper side of the ball. Ivanauskas's extended hand has a simple relaxed defensive pose with distinct fingers.
- Bring Ivanauskas's facial appearance closer to official reference image 3: longer youthful face, blue eyes, straight brown textured fringe, NARROW light brown moustache (not a thick large moustache), otherwise clean-shaven jaw. Keep Garcia's very short hair and long dense full black beard from image 2.
The official reference photos are for likeness ONLY; output must remain a richly hand-drawn ink sports illustration. No photo collage. No team/league/sponsor logos or uniform text/numbers.
Preserve exact existing Japanese text and legibility:
バスケまとめ
2026.10.25
今季平均EFF
岡山 vs 徳島
上位対決を比較
試合前比較｜結果未確認
イラスト（AI生成）
成績をもとにしたイメージ
Do not add names, results, statistics, scores or any extra text. Keep text wholly inside the canvas and unobscured. The scene is conceptual and must not imply a documented play. Produce only the corrected finished thumbnail.
